import importlib.util
sp=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('s','/app/submission/scheduler.py');s=importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp);sp.loader.exec_module(s)
def burst(o):return s.simulate_burst(s.validate_burst(o))
def stream(o):return s.simulate_stream(s.validate_stream(o))
base={'mode':'burst','banks':3,'lanes':1,'limit':10,'borders':[0,10],'start_bank':2,'packets':[{'id':'a','lane':0,'rank':5}]}
x=burst(base)
assert x['ticks']==2 and x['idle']==1 and x['departures']==[{'t':1,'bank':0,'id':'a','rank_error':0,'tie_overtakes':0,'comparable':0}]
base['packets']=[]
x=burst(base);assert x['ticks']==x['idle']==0 and x['departures']==[] and x['ranges']==[{'counts':[0,0,0],'bound':0,'observed':0}]
base={'mode':'burst','banks':2,'lanes':1,'limit':1,'borders':[0,1],'start_bank':1,'packets':[{'id':'old','lane':0,'rank':0},{'id':'new','lane':0,'rank':0}]}
x=burst(base);assert [d['tie_overtakes'] for d in x['departures']]==[1,0] and x['departures'][0]['id']=='new'
base={'mode':'stream','banks':2,'lanes':1,'limit':20,'borders':[0,10,20],'capacity':5,'epoch':1,'steps':[
 {'t':0,'serve':False,'arrivals':[{'id':'a','lane':0,'rank':1}]},
 {'t':100,'serve':False,'arrivals':[{'id':'b','lane':0,'rank':2}]},
 {'t':101,'serve':False,'arrivals':[]},
 {'t':1000,'serve':True,'arrivals':[]},
]}
x=stream(base)
assert x['events'][0]['arrivals'][0]['bank']==0 and x['events'][1]['arrivals'][0]['bank']==0 # reset at k=1
assert x['events'][0]['update'] is None and x['events'][1]['update'] is not None and x['events'][2]['update'] is not None
# Initial pointer was reset again at k=2, but service pointer is unaffected by updates or serve=false.
assert x['events'][3]['service']['bank']==0 and x['events'][3]['service']['packet']['wait']==1000
assert x['final']['totals']['wait_sum']==1000 and x['final']['totals']['wait_max']==1000
# Empty stream is completely inert.
e=stream({'mode':'stream','banks':1,'lanes':1,'limit':1,'borders':[0,1],'capacity':1,'epoch':1,'steps':[]})
assert e=={'events':[],'final':{'borders':[0,1],'weights':[0],'histogram':[0],'rr':[[0]],'next_bank':0,'queues':[[]], 'totals':{'attempted':0,'accepted':0,'dropped':0,'departed':0,'idle':0,'inversions':0,'tie_overtakes':0,'comparable':0,'wait_sum':0,'wait_max':0}}}
print('targeted edge checks OK')
